'''July 2001 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Deep, Huntsville on 14 July 2001. It is known from John Camp's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2658">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1d2658/ huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1], DeckTech (John "1ManScanCrew" Camp, 18 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-huntsville-the-deep-7-14-1d2658/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' The Deep, Huntsville
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 19
